verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs say Model APIs support the OpenAI Chat Completions API so you can use familiar client SDKs. They also show pointing an OpenAI-based client (LangChain's ChatOpenAI) at Baseten by setting `base_url`, which is the base-URL-swap pattern this story describes. missing for 10: an explicit OpenAI SDK example showing that only the base URL and API key change, documentation of compatibility beyond Chat Completions (e.g., other OpenAI endpoints), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: They support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and the Anthropic Messages API in beta, so you can use familiar client SDKs.
Because Baseten exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, you can use LangChain's `ChatOpenAI` with `with_structured_output` by pointing `base_url` at Baseten
Call hosted models through an OpenAI-compatible API
OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints for high-performance LLMs
